dedupe_keys.name: china building carbon emissions uncertainty analysis

description: The China building-emissions team separately deposits an uncertainty-analysis workbook for its city-level operational carbon estimates. The own Figshare item lists one XLSX file and CC0 rights. The describing article says Monte Carlo uncertainty results are supplied for the 2015 to 2020 estimates across 321 cities. A building-system modeller can use the uncertainty results to bound scenario calibration, not treating each published city figure as exact. A caveat is that the uncertainty reflects the study's assumptions and input errors; it does not automatically cover all future policy, technology or occupancy changes. The main emissions workbook has a separate Figshare DOI and should be read with this analysis to interpret units and categories. I read the own Figshare metadata and article Data Records without downloading the workbook, reproducing Monte Carlo draws or checking confidence interval calculations. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
